core_goals: Durable page store: CRUD with derived titles, persistence across store close/reopen.
Graph parity: undirected relations deduped via ordered pairs, self-edges rejected, related pages grouped by category, graph query with per-node degree including degree-0 nodes.
Provenance parity: typed source citations (chat_session, document, connector, file, manual) with drift-tolerant source-ref normalization ([s1]/S1/[D3]/d4).
Settings parity: enabled/use-connectors flags, clearable focus instructions, last-run timestamp with run-completion stamping.

Engine parity: self-improvement run gated on the enabled flag, transcript built with [S#]/[D#] refs (documents only when use_connectors), focus instructions passed to the provider, pages auto-categorized with update-over-duplicate title matching, sources attached via normalized refs, related pages linked, last_run_at stamped.
Expose Onyx /memory list-shape parity helpers for category_counts and category-filtered listing so portable integration tests can assert the same list semantics as the Onyx stack.
Wire Brain into Grok Build’s real prompt/request path so normal user requests can create durable Brain records and later requests receive recalled context through the shipped request builder.
Fully port the portable Onyx Python Brain data/run logic, not just direct remember prompts, including bounded session-history backfill from Grok JSONL sessions.

features.description: Create, read, list (newest-updated first), update, and delete memory pages with title derivation from the first sentence when absent; data persists across closing and reopening the store file.
features.name: Memory page store

features.description: Undirected page-to-page edges stored once per ordered pair (dedup in either direction), self-edge and unknown-page rejection, edge removal, related-pages query grouped by category, and a graph query returning all nodes with degrees (degree-0 nodes included) plus edges.
features.name: Relations and memory graph

features.description: Typed citations (chat_session, document, connector, file, manual) attach to and list for a page with label capping, and source-ref normalization tolerates bracket/case drift without silently dropping citations.
features.name: Source citations

features.description: Enabled flag, use-connectors flag, optional focus-instructions text (whitespace clears), and last-run timestamp round-trip through get/update; a run-completion operation stamps the timestamp; settings persist across reopen.
features.name: Brain settings

features.description: run_self_improvement builds an [S#]/[D#]-tagged transcript from session/document context (documents only when use_connectors), passes focus instructions and existing titles to a pluggable ExtractionProvider, applies extracted pages into the four categories with update-over-duplicate title matching, attaches per-page sources via normalized refs, links related pages, skips entirely when disabled, and stamps last_run_at on completed runs.
features.name: Self-improvement run engine

features.description: The ported Onyx test suite (test_memory_recall_and_graph.py, the suite behind the Onyx testsprite brain-graph script) passes against the Rust crate with the same seed data, topology, and assertions.
features.name: Onyx behavioral parity

features.description: Library equivalent of Onyx's testsprite memory_demo_populate.py: populate memories across all four categories, report total and per-category counts, expose all nodes in the graph as degree-0 before linking, run the self-improvement pipeline to refresh/recall the codename page without duplicating it, attach a chat-session citation via normalized refs, link related pages, then clean up and verify the store is empty.
features.name: Portable live-demo lifecycle parity

features.description: The xai-grok-shell prompt path opens the durable Grok Brain store, processes user-originated remember requests before model sampling, persists a Brain page with title/category/source citation, and injects recalled Brain context into the real ChatStateActor request-building memory reminder path for later fresh requests.
features.name: Grok Build request-path Brain wiring

features.description: The wired service respects disabled settings (no create/no recall), initializes a normal Grok store enabled only when unconfigured, and exposes deterministic-provider self-improvement through the Grok Build service boundary for tests without network LLM calls.
features.name: Brain integration settings and deterministic self-improvement

features.description: Port the portable behavior of Onyx brain.py and brain/tasks.py into Grok Build: bounded recent-session selection with last-run cutoff, max session/message/transcript/document/page/source caps, persisted Grok session JSONL parsing, connector/document toggle, focus instructions, source-ref normalization, update-not-duplicate by title, source dedup, relation linking, and last-run stamping.
features.name: Full Onyx Brain Python run/backfill parity

product_overview: xai-grok-brain is a Rust library crate in the grok-build workspace providing a durable, single-user 'Brain': a SQLite-backed graph of memory pages with four categories (notes, concepts, entities, workstreams), undirected page-to-page relations, typed source citations, per-store brain settings, and a self-improvement run engine behind a pluggable extraction provider. It ports the Onyx/Perplexity Brain domain layer with parity semantics; HTTP endpoints, UI, and scheduling are out of scope.
requirements: cargo build -p xai-grok-brain compiles with no errors and cargo clippy -p xai-grok-brain reports no warnings.
The crate's full cargo test suite (unit + consumer + onyx_parity integration tests) passes deterministically on repeated runs.
Graph invariants hold: duplicate edges collapse, self-edges error, degree-0 nodes appear in the graph query output.
Drifted source refs [s1], S1, [D3], d4 all resolve to their canonical S#/D# keys.
A disabled store never invokes the extraction provider and never stamps last_run_at; an enabled run stamps it even when no pages are produced.

The portable live-demo lifecycle test passes: category counts match the populated all-category seed set, graph nodes appear before linking, the self-improvement run updates rather than duplicates the codename page, sources and relations are attached, and cleanup leaves an empty store.

Shell integration tests pass: process_brain_request_at_path creates a page/source for a remember request, reopens the store, recalls the value for a later fresh request, and the recalled context is injected via ChatStateActor::build_request.

Integration settings tests pass: disabled Brain blocks create/recall, and deterministic-provider self-improvement through BrainService creates/updates categorized pages, sources, relations, and last-run timestamp.

Backfill launch test passes: fake persisted Grok sessions are parsed, bounded, converted to [S#]/[D#] context, passed to a deterministic provider, applied to the durable store, and later recalled through the public request service.

Adversarial backfill tests pass for recent-window/last-run cutoff, max sessions/messages/docs, connector toggling, source-ref drift, unknown refs, repeated run update-not-duplicate, relation/source dedup, and empty/no-session stamping.
